I replied in #coastal-team, in Bettina's thread, that I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest.

Nothing is scheduled. The only scheduler I can reach is a local cron job, and its output is not delivered to Slack, so it can't post the digest in the channel. I didn't create a job or post anything else.

I offered to write the digest by hand when she asks, covering last week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random plus open customer items, with finance figures left out. Someone with admin access would need to set up a scheduled Slack post for the Monday 08:00 run.
